home.title: Accenture • Work & Co Senior Design Lead • Carl Avidano
home.description: Carl Avidano’s selected work for the Senior Design Lead opportunity at Work & Co, part of Accenture Song: product strategy, visual design, interactive tools, and accessible design systems.
home.headline: I’m a senior product designer who builds design systems, conducts research, and leads design teams.
home.introduction: Work & Co is looking for a designer who can shape the strategy, refine the interface, and stay involved through implementation. I bring that experience: I’ve led UX for city services, designed interactive science tools, and built an open-source design system. I can guide a design team while contributing directly to the design and code, with accessibility informing the work throughout.
home.projectsIntroduction: These case studies show how I connect product strategy with visual design, develop interactive tools, and work with clients and developers to bring the details into production.
home.who: I’m a New York–based product designer, UX leader, and inclusive design advocate with more than 15 years of experience. During nearly four years as UX Director at Reingold, I led the overall UX strategy for the redesign of Phoenix.gov, serving more than 1.5 million residents. My work there also included the NFL, St. Jude Global, and Maximus. Since 2011, I’ve run Avidano Digital, building long-term partnerships with nonprofit and education clients.
home.what: I lead product design from research and early concepts through visual design and implementation. I work through interactions in wireframes, explain decisions to clients, and refine the experience with developers. I stay hands-on in Figma and front-end code while guiding designers and building accessible components that teams can reuse.
